text:
jun: Heads-up — nightly fused-attn perf regression when paged_kv is enabled, saw ~15% tail latency increase on Llama-30b-ish. :thinking_face:

sarah: repro-able in nightly job? which config?

jun: yes, job id nb-2026-03-17-0312. Config snippet below. Repro is pretty stable on our infra.

jun: ```json
{
  "paged_kv": true,
  "fused_qkv_pack": true,
  "epilogue_fuse": "bias+rope",
  "batch_size": 8,
  "seq_len": 1024
}
```

mike: saw something similar in canary last week but thought it was noise. good call. suspect page-fault / working-set interaction with fused epilogue.

perf-bot: [perf-alert] nightly/regression: fused-attn (qkv-pack + bias+rope) increased p95 by 14.7% vs baseline. Group: attention-kernels. Issue: #3124

jun: nvprof snapshot (trimmed):

jun: ```
Kernel                         Time(ms)  Calls
fused_qkv_epilogue_biasrope     2.42      128
fused_qkv_epilogue_nonfused     1.95      128
paged_kv_page_load              0.12      512
```

jun: You'll see epilogue path jumps from ~1.95->2.42ms when paged_kv is on. Not huge per-call but adds up across tokens.

alex: quick mitigation: gate epilogue fusion when paged_kv==true? If that restores perf, we can ship a targeted rollback.

sarah: I ran A/B: disable epilogue_fuse -> p95 back to baseline, CPU/GPU counters look cleaner.

mike: reproducing locally now. Flamegraph shows additional stalls waiting on memory loads in the fused path when pages are actively being fetched. Link: http://perf.internal/fg/2234567890 (private) :chart_with_upwards_trend:

jun: my working hypothesis: qkv-pack layout + epilogue fused writes touch memory in a pattern that crosses page boundaries, causing more page loads and stranding the kernel while waiting for device-side page fetches. Paged KV is orthogonal but exposes the layout sensitivity.

eva: proposed plan:
- short-term: gate epilogue_fuse behind paged_kv flag (disable when paged_kv==true)
- medium: add microbench (seq x batch sweep) to prevent regressions in CI
- long-term: change kernel memory layout to be page-friendly or add prefetch for paged-kv path

mike: I can instrument with CUPTI and add per-kernel page-fault counters, and run a microbench sweep. Taking ownership (mike). ETA EOD. :hammer_and_wrench:

sarah: I'll run broad model matrix (7b/13b/30b) across batch sizes and seq lengths to characterize boundary conditions. Posting numbers to the issue.

alex: I'll open a small PR to gate the epilogue fuse behind paged_kv until we have a fix.

perf-bot: created issue https://tracker.redwood/3124 and linked nightly alerts.

jun: also suggesting to rollback patch 0f3a7 (that enabled default epilogue_fuse for pack path) for the dedicated clusters until we root-cause. Otherwise customers hit this on sequences >512.

mike: quick update after tracing: there's an inner loop that copies per-token bias with stride that, combined with packed layout, ends up touching adjacent KV pages. I'm seeing extra global memory load stalls. Looking into reordering to make writes/touches contiguous per-page.

jun: very useful. If reordering fixes it we can re-enable but gated by a perf test.

eva: I'll add microbench harness and a regression check that fails CI if p95 increases >5% compared to baseline for any attention kernel.

sarah: early numbers: 13b shows ~18% regression when seq>512 and batch>=4; 7b shows smaller impact, 30b similar to 13b. Will paste full table in the issue.

mike: pushed WIP branch with instrumentation and small loop reorder patch for local test. Preliminary locally shows ~8-10% improvement vs gated-off path. Need more runs.

alex: PR to gate feature is up: https://git.redwood/pr/5402 — marking as rollback hotfix candidate.

jun: thanks all. Action items: mike digs kernel mem access + fix; sarah full matrix; alex gate/rollback PR; eva adds microbench/regression test; i'll monitor alerts and coordinate rollback if needed. :thumbsup:

mike: will post CUPTI traces and callgraph later today.

sarah: leaving a note to customer-facing on-call to expect possible latency blips during rollback window.

jun: update thread when we have root cause PR or decide to keep gate permanent.
